summary: Chipbox, a chiptune groovebox firmware built on Dinghy that emulates more than 35 sound chips from consoles and computers, mixed freely as channels on a 16-step page sequencer.
features: Over 35 chips incl. NES, Game Boy, Mega Drive, C64 SID, OPL
Up to 16 channels, each one voice of any chip
16-step pages chained into a song; step entry or live recording
Pages of 16 steps chained into a song; step entry or live recording
Punch-in effects and kick ducking per channel
Bluetooth sync with sibling firmwares (not standard BLE-MIDI)
